service.catalogClaim: Inventory only. Provider directories are not claimed as supported or verified.

scope: durable validation/discovery jobs and restart recovery
Oracle AST, discovery, limits, and driver read-only transaction
durable tenant REST idempotency, OAuth bearer, pagination, and rate limit
MCP definition encryption, allowlists, schema rejection, and timeout
Web Discovery token, origin, redirect, cookie, CSRF, and confirmation controls
file scan, deduplication, parsing, and preview

security: SSRF loopback target rejected before transport
Oracle multi-statement, DML, FOR UPDATE, package calls, and database links rejected by AST gate
driver-level Oracle read-only transaction and rollback
ZIP central-directory traversal and compression limits enforced
CSV and XLSX spreadsheet formulas rejected
encrypted connection, file metadata, lease, and revocation survive SQLite restart
ACL/visibility/revocation changes cascade to active leases
durable REST idempotency stores hashed keys and encrypted results
lease token is not persisted; only SHA-256 hash is stored

fileParsePreviews.pdf: passed with real 10-page PDF and 4515 extracted characters
fileParsePreviews.parquet: passed with real ZSTD Parquet and 17 preview rows

realOracle.command: npx --no-install tsx scripts/step2b-oracle-e2e.ts with STEP2B_ORACLE_* environment variables

covered: explicit origin, operation, and read/write confirmation

feishu.environmentObservation: A separate lark-cli user session successfully read the real design document, but this is not Connection Service E2E evidence and has broader scopes.

performance.classification: single-machine service-local baseline; not production capacity evidence

largeFileUpload.limitation: TenantFileAdapter buffers the object for scanning and hashing; streaming file processing is not implemented or evidenced.

pending: production-like CPU and peak memory telemetry

blockers: Connection Service-owned Feishu OAuth resource read and post-revocation denial are not evidenced.
The isolated Web Discovery browser worker is not deployed or exercised end to end.
Oracle VPC/private runner and optional SSH transport are not implemented or evidenced.
MCP reconnect and network-disconnect behavior are not evidenced with a real process.
The full wrong-credential, timeout, disconnect, and revocation provider matrix is incomplete.
Large-file scanning and hashing buffer the full file instead of streaming.
Full 50-concurrent-invocation and long-conversation stability tests with production-like telemetry are pending.
Real PDF, Parquet, and XLSX E2E fixtures are machine-local and must be provisioned by the release runner.
